stories.title: St. Joseph candidate pushes moratorium to block data centers
stories.dek: A candidate for St. Joseph County Council is calling for a temporary halt on data-center proposals. Residents would face sudden spikes in power bills and water use if large facilities arrive without local rules. The push comes as other Michigan counties scramble to write their own limits before projects land.
stories.source_title: St. Joseph County Council candidate calls for data center moratorium - WNDU

stories.title: Township leaders threatened as data center land battle explodes online
stories.dek: A viral clip sparked threats against township leaders weighing a data center proposal. The episode shows how raw local fights over power use and land are getting. Officials must still decide on the project amid the backlash.
stories.source_title: Tyrone Twp. officials face death threats after viral data center clip - Livingston Daily

stories.title: Mason County residents push back on data center plans
stories.dek: A commission heard from opponents and the public on a proposed center's power and land impacts. Local pushback could force changes or delays to the project. The hearing gives residents a direct say before bigger decisions.
stories.source_title: Mason County Commission hears presentation from data center opponent, and public comments - WV News

stories.title: Tech industry pours $300K into congressional primary over data center stakes
stories.dek: A super PAC linked to artificial intelligence interests spent nearly $300,000 in a Michigan congressional primary. The money targets a race where data center policy is an emerging issue. Voters in the district will decide the outcome next week.
stories.source_title: Super PAC tied to AI spends $295K on US House race in Michigan - Detroit Free Press

stories.title: Houghton County readies rules before data centers arrive
stories.dek: Houghton, Hancock and Portage Township officials are drafting zoning and permitting standards now. Early action could limit power and water demands on rural Upper Peninsula grids and aquifers. Residents want protections before any large projects are proposed.
stories.source_title: Houghton, Hancock, and Portage Township seeking to address data center developments before the industry can arrive - The Keweenaw Report

stories.title: Detroit News urges Michigan to set data center rules now
stories.dek: The editorial board argues the state should welcome data centers but only with strong local protections. It points to electricity costs and water strain already hitting other states. Michigan communities still have time to write their own standards before projects land.
stories.source_title: With the right guardrails, data centers should be embraced | Opinion - The Detroit News

stories.title: DTE queue for data centers tops 8GW after Oracle, Google deals
stories.dek: DTE Electric now lists more than 8 gigawatts of proposed data-center load, driven by signed agreements with Oracle and Google. The surge means higher power demand that will shape rates and grid upgrades for southeast Michigan customers. Residents will feel the effects through future bills and decisions on where new transmission lines and substations are built.
stories.source_title: Michigan utility DTE data center pipeline increases to more than 8GW, on the back of deals with Oracle and Google - Data Center Dynamics

stories.title: Data Center Battles Loom for Michigan Senate Primary Candidates
stories.dek: El-Sayed and Stevens seek the Democratic nomination in the Aug. 4 primary; the winner could shape federal rules on projects already sparking local fights over sites and impacts.

stories.title: Bellevue residents demand answers on data center water and power use
stories.dek: Neighbors in Bellevue want concrete numbers on how much electricity and water the proposed facility would pull from local supplies. Eaton County residents worry higher utility rates and strained wells could follow if the project moves ahead without more transparency. The push for details comes as data centers across Michigan seek big new connections to the grid.
stories.source_title: Area residents seek more details on data center proposal - Bellevue Herald Leader

stories.title: DTE lands big data-center contracts even after missing earnings targets
stories.dek: DTE’s latest quarterly slides show new data-center deals are driving growth despite an earnings miss. Those deals will shape future power rates and grid investments across southeast Michigan. Ratepayers ultimately pay for the infrastructure needed to serve the new load.
stories.source_title: DTE Q2 2026 slides: data center deals fuel growth despite earnings miss - Investing.com

stories.title: Teacher cuffed at Michigan meeting for clapping against data center
stories.dek: A teacher was arrested after clapping during public comments opposing a data center proposal at a city commission meeting in Michigan's Upper Peninsula. The incident highlights how heated local fights over data centers have become. Residents worry about noise, power rates, and water use from the projects.
stories.source_title: Teacher arrested for repeatedly clapping in favor of data center opponents during city commission meeting - Upper Michigan's Source

national.title: Data centers advance rapidly as regulators scramble for rules
national.dek: Across the U.S., officials race to impose guardrails on power-hungry facilities while communities push back on incentives and impacts.
